title: Full Procure-to-Pay Chain
phase: Second-Pass Depth Closure — P1 Core Business
chain_steps: Receipt validate (_action_done: _set_value at PO price, no account.move for standard receipt)
Vendor bill post (_post: DR stock_valuation, CR payable; SVL updated to billed amount)
Anglo-Saxon adjustment (optional: DR price_diff, CR stock_valuation when bill_price != standard_cost)
Payment journal entry (DR payable, CR bank/outstanding)
Reconcile (reconcile() on payable lines: amount_residual=0, bill state='paid')
PO fully billed (invoice_status='invoiced' when qty_to_invoice=0 for all lines)
key_architectural_notes: NO accounting entry at receipt for standard supplier→stock moves in Odoo 19. The valuation_account_id guard in _should_create_account_move() prevents entry when neither source (supplier) nor dest (internal stock) location has valuation_account_id set.
Bill posting is the singular accounting event: DR stock_valuation + CR payable created at _post().
SVL value update: after bill post, _set_value() on linked incoming moves updates move.value from PO price to actual billed amount.
Anglo-Saxon accounting (optional): _stock_account_prepare_anglo_saxon_in_lines_vals() adds price difference lines when company.anglo_saxon_accounting=True and product cost_method=standard.
Payment reconciliation: wizard._post_payments() then _reconcile_payments() matches payable AMls on both sides.
